description: This file contains unit tests for system normalization helper functions using Vitest. It tests functions that normalize non-empty strings and string arrays.

methods.name: normalizeNonEmptyString
methods.description: Normalizes input to a non-empty string or null if input is invalid or empty.

methods.name: normalizeStringArray
methods.description: Converts input array to an array of strings with whitespace trimmed, filtering out invalid entries.
